signConvention: amounts UNSIGNED, Soll/Haben column (S = debit, H = credit) gives the direction
notes: Monthly salary (2845,50) is marked H (Haben = credit) and must not be detected as a charge.
Header uses German names: Buchungstag, Soll/Haben, Auftraggeber / Begünstigter, Verwendungszweck, Betrag (€).
Dates are DD.MM.YYYY, amounts use comma decimals.
